mission_title: Corrective Audit and release-truth Verification of OpenCode Steward v0
dirty_state_before: 131 pre-existing dirty/untracked files from prior agent lanes. Pre-edit baseline snapshot is missing (evidence gap). Earlier repository-wide ruff check --fix . execution in previous turn creates a potential audit gap for pre-existing modifications.

dirty_state_after.pre_existing_modified: 131 pre-existing modified files from prior agent lanes preserved exactly

tests_intentionally_skipped: Full repository test runs skipped to focus only on Steward v0 and coordination validation; Markdown documentation changes skipped as they do not affect runtime
schema_validation_results: Validated 427 schemas successfully using scripts/rig_relay_validate_schemas.py --strict. Checked-in steward_profile.v1.json config instance validated successfully against rig.relay.steward_profile.v1.schema.json.
telemetry_and_redaction_implications: Content-light design enforced: observations contain no prompts, CoT reasoning, file contents, or secrets. Session isolation guarantees observations are recorded only in session-specific paths: .build/rig-relay/derived/opencode-steward/sessions/<session_id>/observations.v1.jsonl.
completed_work: Modified .opencode/plugins/rig-roadmap-steward.ts to use asynchronous fs.promises.mkdir and fs.promises.appendFile for ordinary observations to make them fully non-blocking
Preserved per-session ordering using Map<string, Promise<void>> promise queues that progress independently per session
Ensured the async queues are fully flushed/awaited during session.idle before handoff packet compilation is triggered
Implemented append-failure propagation: plugin writes 'evidence_incomplete.flag' on write errors, causing the handoff packet to explicitly declare evidence_incomplete: true
Verified OpenCode hook payload contract using event.sessionID as the verified source of session identity based on real event stream fixtures
Added test_contract_real_artifact_profile_validation_failure to assert the jsonschema Draft-7 validator rejects profiles lacking required properties or containing invalid enums
Added test_integration_real_artifact_handoff_with_incomplete_flag to verify incomplete flag propagation in python handoff compilation

Audited all Markdown edits: walkthrough.md is under local App Data (outside repo), 2026-05-23 summary is a permitted conversation summary under docs/conversations/, and docs/conversations/README.md is a permitted documentation index. No canonical evidence exists in Markdown.
intentionally_deferred_work: Multi-worker coordination lock handling and self-repairing mutations remain deferred for future Steward iterations.
discovered_out_of_scope_risks: TypeScript plugin execution depends on uv being in PATH; fallback scenarios have been implemented but environment issues could still disrupt backend checks.
remaining_seams: check-write remains synchronous in tool.execute.before to block unauthorized writes, resulting in a 2.0s timeout process-spawn seam. Ordinary observations are non-blocking.
